title: Australian Sky & Telescope magazine – JULY 2018 ISSUE 110

body:
Sky & Telescope magazine brings astronomy to hobbyists across the globe — a significant fraction of our readers live outside North America, and many readers live in the Southern Hemisphere. So we’re proud to showcase the Australia edition of Sky & Telescope, which features astronomy research Down Under as well as Southern Hemisphere sky maps. Look for Australian Sky & Telescope on newsstands in Australia and New Zealand.
